acceptance_criteria.criterion: A LoadJsonNode class exists in nodes.py with node ID Mistralys_LoadJson and display name "JSON Load File".
The node shows a dropdown listing all .json files (recursively) from ComfyUI's input directory.
Selecting a file and executing the node outputs the parsed dict as a JSON_OBJECT.
Non-dict top-level JSON values produce a clear ValueError.
Malformed JSON files produce a clear ValueError including the parse error.
Path traversal attempts (e.g. ../../etc/passwd) are rejected — the resolved path must stay within the input directory.
The node re-executes when the selected file's content changes on disk (mtime-based fingerprinting).
The node uses cached output when the file is unchanged between runs.
The node is registered in __init__.py and appears in ComfyUI's node menu under the "json" category.
